facts.statement: The only known species of the genus Panguraptor is Panguraptor lufengensis.
facts.quote: The type and only known species is Panguraptor lufengensis.

facts.statement: Panguraptor was described in 2014 by You Hai-Lu and colleagues.
facts.quote: It was described in 2014 by You Hai-Lu and colleagues.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was discovered by a survey team on a hillside behind Xiaolishu Village in Lufeng County, China.
facts.quote: The specimen that would be named Panguraptor was discovered by a survey team of the Bureau of Land and Resources of Lufeng County, China, on the hillside behind Xiaolishu Village, Lufeng Dinosaur Mountain Town.

facts.statement: Because of weathering, the partially exposed skeleton was glued and plastered on site over two days before being shipped to a museum.
facts.quote: The team found the partially articulated skeleton exposed on the slope on . Due to weathering, there was not time to slowly clean the skeleton, so it was glued and plastered on location over the course of two days before being shipped to Lufeng World Dinosaur Valley.

facts.statement: The fossil catalogued as LFGT-0103 was formally described in 2014 as the type specimen of Panguraptor lufengensis.
facts.quote: In 2014 the fossil, catalogued as Bureau of Land and Resources of Lufeng County LFGT-0103, was described by Chinese paleontologist Hailu You and colleagues as the type specimen of the new theropod Panguraptor lufengensis.

facts.statement: The sediments containing Panguraptor are dated to the late Sinemurian to possibly Toarcian stages.
facts.quote: Sediments that Panguraptor were found in correspond to the Shawan Member of the Lufeng Formation. These beds have also been known as the Dull Purplish Beds of the Lower Lufeng Formation, and have been dated using magnetostratigraphy to the late Sinemurian to possibly Toarcian.

facts.statement: The specimen is estimated to have been approximately 2 meters long in life.
facts.quote: This specimen is likely a sub-adult due to its small size (approximately 2 meters long in life), large orbit, and unfused scapulocoracoids and astragalocalcaneum.

facts.statement: The preserved teeth are slightly recurved but unserrated.
facts.quote: Teeth are preserved in the dentary and maxilla, and are slightly recurved yet unserrated.

facts.statement: The hand has four digits, with the first and second metacarpals being the widest.
facts.quote: The hand has four digits, with metacarpals I and II being the widest and metatarsals II and III being the longest.

facts.statement: The first digit possesses a flattened and recurved claw, which is the largest claw in the holotype.
facts.quote: The first digit also has a flattened and recurved claw, the largest found in the holotype.

facts.statement: Panguraptor is distinguished from other coelophysids by a diagonal ridge on the maxilla, an elliptical fenestra, and a distal tarsal IV with a hooked corner.
facts.quote: Panguraptor can be distinguished from other coelophysids by the following traits: A diagonal ridge on the lateral surface of the maxilla, within the antorbital fossa. An elliptical fenestra (also known in Zupaysaurus) caudodorsal to the above-mentioned ridge. a distal tarsal IV with a hooked craniomedial corner.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis places Panguraptor in a clade with Coelophysis, Megapnosaurus, and Camposaurus.
facts.quote: You et al. (2014) performed a phylogenetic analysis and found Panguraptor to be a coelophysid coelophysoid, in a clade with Coelophysis, Megapnosaurus (referred to Coelophysis rhodesiensis), and Camposaurus but not "Syntarsus" kayentakatae.

facts.statement: Panguraptor is considered the first coelophysoid known from Asia.
facts.quote: Per this analysis, Panguraptor would be the first coelophysoid known from Asia.

facts.statement: A 2026 analysis recovered Panguraptor as a basal member of the superfamily Coelophysoidea.
facts.quote: In 2026, Zhang and colleagues recovered Panguraptor as a basal (early-diverging) member of the superfamily Coelophysoidea in their phylogenetic analyses.

facts.statement: Panguraptor lived during the Early Jurassic, approximately 199.3 million years ago.
facts.quote: Panguraptor lufengensis es la única especie conocida del género extinto Panguraptor de dinosaurio terópodo celofísido, que vivió a principios del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 199.3 millones de años, en el Sinemuriano, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Panguraptor possessed a vertebral column with ten cervical vertebrae and thirteen sacral vertebrae.
facts.quote: La columna vertebral tiene diez vértebras cervicales y trece vértebras sacrales.

facts.statement: The foot of Panguraptor included a rudimentary fifth metatarsal bone.
facts.quote: El pie tiene un quinto metatarsiano rudimentario.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, LFGT-0103, is a partial articulated skeleton of a subadult individual.
facts.quote: El holotipo de Panguraptor, LFGT-0103, es el esqueleto articulado parcial de un individuo subadulto

facts.statement: The holotype was likely a subadult measuring approximately 2 meters in length when alive.
facts.quote: Este espécimen es probablemente un subadulto debido a su pequeño tamaño, aproximadamente 2 metros de largo en vida

facts.statement: The exposed nasal portions of Panguraptor are wide and smooth, lacking a sagittal crest found in some other basal theropods.
facts.quote: Las porciones expuestas de la nariz son anchas y lisas y no muestran ningún signo de cresta sagital presente en algunos otros terópodos basales.

facts.statement: Conserved teeth in the dentary and maxilla were slightly recurved but lacked serrations.
facts.quote: Los dientes se conservan en el dentario y maxilar, y son ligeramente recurvados pero sin serrar.

facts.statement: The hand had four digits, with the first and second metacarpals being the widest and the second and third metatarsals the longest.
facts.quote: La mano tiene cuatro dígitos, siendo los metacarpianos I y II los más anchos y los metatarsianos II y III los más largos.

facts.statement: The first toe possessed a flattened, recurved claw that was the largest found in the holotype.
facts.quote: El primer dedo también tiene una garra aplanada y recurvada, la más grande encontrada en el holotipo.

facts.statement: Panguraptor is distinguished from other coelophysids by a diagonal crest on the lateral maxilla, an elliptical fenestra, and a distal tarsal IV with a cranomedial hook-shaped corner.
facts.quote: Panguraptor se puede distinguir de otros celofísidos por los siguientes rasgos, una cresta diagonal en la superficie lateral del maxilar, dentro de la fosa antorbitaria, una fenestra elíptica, también conocida en Zupaysaurus, caudodorsal a la cresta antes mencionada y un tarso distal IV con una esquina craneomedial en forma de gancho.

facts.statement: The species name refers to its origin in the Lufeng Formation in Yunnan Province.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie se refiere a su lugar de origen, la Formación Lufeng, en la provincia de Yunnan.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was recovered on October 12, 2007, from the Lufeng Formation in Yunnan.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotipo fue recuperado el 12 de octubre de 2007 de la Formación Lufeng de Yunnan

facts.statement: The genus was described in 2014 by You Hai-Lu and colleagues.
facts.quote: Fue descrito en 2014 por You Hai-Lu y sus colegas.

facts.statement: Cladistic analysis places Panguraptor within Coelophysoidea and specifically within the family Coelophysidae.
facts.quote: Según un análisis cladístico del artículo de descripción, Panguraptor es miembro de Coelophysoidea y dentro de este, de Coelophysidae.

facts.statement: Panguraptor is more closely related to Coelophysis bauri than to "Syntarsus" kayentakatae.
facts.quote: Panguraptor está más estrechamente relacionado con Coelophysis bauri que "Syntarsus" kayentakatae.

facts.statement: Panguraptor represents the first good material of a coelophysid found in China or even Asia.
facts.quote: Panguraptor representa el primer buen material de celofisoideo en China, o incluso de Asia

facts.statement: Panguraptor lived during the Hettangian stage, between 201.4 and 199.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Hettangian to Hettangian (201.4 to 199.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: The skull is quite short and nearly complete, though the premaxilla, rostral margin of the maxilla, and nasals are partially missing or destroyed.
facts.quote: El cráneo bastante corto está casi completo, aunque faltan el premaxilar y el borde rostral del maxilar y los nasales están parcialmente destruidos.

facts.statement: Other small coelophysid specimens from the Lufeng Formation, such as FMNH CUP 2089 and FMNH CUP 2090, may belong to Panguraptor but have been provisionally named "Megapnosaurus" kayentakatae pending further analysis.
facts.quote: Otros especímenes pequeños de celofisoides como FMNH CUP 2089, algunos huesos de las extremidades anteriores y FMNH CUP 2090, algunos huesos de las extremidades traseras) recuperados de la formación Lufeng pueden pertenecer a esta especie, aunque se les ha denominado provisionalmente como "Megapnosaurus" kayetakatae hasta su posterior análisis.
